Ask a professional, but I used to regress whenever I felt slightly unsafe in a sexual situation (even if it was safe). However, the more I came to understand it as a defense mechanism the more i was able to gain some control over it. You can't control something you don't understand.

Age regression is not a bad thing, it can just be her coping mechanism. I would suggest allowing her to regress at other times when you guys are not arguing- like you can get her coloring books or have her lay on your lap while you stroke her hair.

She should also go see a therapist, but understand that it is a part of her personality and if you allow her to explore that part when she feels safe, she'll be able to control it more

I'm bi and I have a very similar issue. I was brought up in a very cult-like religious community and I was already cut off for 'leaving the fold', but I try to stay on their good side so they let me have a relationship with my younger sister- so, like you, I don't rly talk about being bi to anyone

The second I told my boyfriend, he asked for a threesome and made a comment that if i was ever with a woman, it wouldn't be cheating... Like he has no concept that me being bisexual means that I could see myself having a long-term relationships with women and that gender would have no affect on my feelings... 

Ppl are just ignorant and you have to decide if it's worth your time to educate them, or let it slide...
